 Deepika Padukone, Katrina Kaif twin in yellow ethnic outfits, celebrate cosy family Diwali with their kids; see unseen pictures
 Deepika Padukone-Ranveer Singh and Katrina Kaif-Vicky Kaushal celebrated Diwali 2026 with their families and children, skipping Bollywood parties. Deepika and Katrina coincidentally twinned in yellow traditional outfits at their respective celebrations.
 By 
 Ruchita 
 November 11, 2026 18:57 IST 
 Deepika Padukone, Katrina Kaif twin in yellow ethnic outfits, celebrate cosy family Diwali with their kids; see unseen pictures Instagram 
 While Bollywood celebrities are busy attending Diwali parties and visiting each other's homes, decking up in ethnic outfits designed by Manish Malhotra, Anamika Khanna and others, Deepika Padukone and Ranveer Singh, along with Katrina Kaif and Vicky Kaushal, chose to celebrate Diwali with their families and little ones.
 Deepika and Ranveer celebrated their first Diwali with their second daughter, Devi, making the occasion extra special. Unseen pictures from the couple's Diwali celebration have gone viral on social media. The couple, along with their friends, were seen enjoying a cosy and intimate family lunch. However, the pictures did not feature their daughters, Dua and Devi.
 Deepika Padukone, Katrina Kaif twin in yellow ethnic outfits, celebrate cosy family Diwali with their kids; see unseen pictures Instagram 
 Actors and celebrity couple Ranveer Singh and Deepika Padukone celebrated Diwali 2026 with their family and close friends in Bengaluru.
 Deepika Padukone, Katrina Kaif twin in yellow ethnic outfits, celebrate cosy family Diwali with their kids; see unseen pictures Instagram 
 One picture shows Ranveer and Deepika posing with Deepika's parents, Prakash and Ujjala Padukone, her sister Anisha and close friends. Another picture features Deepika posing at Amiel Gourmet Restaurant in Bengaluru, dressed in a beautiful yellow ethnic suit set. Ranveer, meanwhile, looked dapper in a purple kurta paired with a silk brocade jacket.  Another picture shows Ranveer happily posing for a selfie with a fan.
 Deepika Padukone, Katrina Kaif twin in yellow ethnic outfits, celebrate cosy family Diwali with their kids; see unseen pictures Instagram 
 Katrina Kaif, meanwhile, made fans' Diwali special by revealing the face of her son, Vihaan. The beautiful picture captures Katrina and Vicky holding their little one as he tries to stand, happily smiling and posing for the camera. The couple are seen looking lovingly at their son.
 The unseen viral pictures also show Katrina in a yellow outfit posing with a fan or staff member, while Vicky is seen wearing an ivory kurta-pyjama.
 Coincidentally, Katrina and Deepika were seen wearing yellow traditional outfits, coincidentally twinning in their respective Diwali celebrations.
